title: 電気製図
subtitle: Drawing Skills for Electrical and Electronic Engineering
educationalGoal: The aim of this course is to help students acquire the necessary skills and knowledge needed to read and draw drawings. Students will: (1) Learn drawing skills in electrical engineering. (2) Learn drawing fundamentals such as standards and line usage. (3) Draw mechanical elements and electrical circuits.
advice: Reading and drawing drawings correctly is an essential ability for electrical engineers. Electrical drawing is necessary to design and implement circuits, and are also essential to accurately transmit specifications to others. Although it is also necessary to draw a figure freehand, the ability to draw the exact drawings used in a design according to a standard is important to the electrical engineer. It is expected that those skills will be acquired through this course.
requiredKnowledge: Students who have learning experience in drawing should make use the knowledge in learning this course. Students need to prepare drafters such as rulers, compasses and templates.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand and explain line types, letters and symbols used in drawing.
Be able to draw and explain electric circuits according to JIS standard.
Be able to understand and explain basic mechanical drawing.
